details: Existing baseline has170 source-layout findings and stale candidate/catalog bindings. Cache capture must preserve exact current bytes and original declared hashes/statuses as distinct observations, never repair hashes or promote roles/evidence to make snapshot pass. Exact first-party source/path/role universe comes from current Git membership and the candidate membership set; stale proof receipts remain explicitly stale. New Lean sources will be registered by root before final real snapshot. Preservation-complete byte capture is not whole-repository mathematical acceptance. Record missing/inconsistent catalog metadata as findings rather than falsely accepting it.
